breaking_news.headline: Why is gasoline suddenly under $4 a gallon?
breaking_news.summary: The average price of a gallon of gasoline dipped below $4 this week for the first time in months. Does that mean more relief is coming for drivers?

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid alleged spy scandal
breaking_news.summary: Huang co-founded the chipmaker Nvidia, which has become one of the driving forces behind the AI boom. But reports that he may have had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy quickly sank his career.

breaking_news.headline: Jensen Huang biographer reacts to the Nvidia CEO's resignation
breaking_news.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Stephen Witt, author of a Jensen Huang biography, about his resignation from his role as CEO of Nvidia.

breaking_news.headline: 'Punch in the gut': Homes sales fall to their lowest in 16 years
breaking_news.summary: Existing homes sales in October declined 8.8% from a year earlier, according to the National Association of Realtors.

breaking_news.headline: CEO Jensen Huang resigns from chip giant Nvidia
breaking_news.summary: The chip giant Nvidia announced that CEO Jensen Huang was stepping down following allegations that he'd had extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

breaking_news.headline: A negative Outlook: Microsoft scrambles to fix email outage
breaking_news.summary: Early Friday, after Outlook had been down for more than 12 hours, Microsoft reported "marginal success."

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX's giant rocket may leave NASA in the dust
breaking_news.summary: As it races to develop its new massive rocket, the space launch company is preparing to retire NASA's main ride to the International Space Station.

breaking_news.headline: Does Europe regret its bet on U.S. defense?
breaking_news.summary: Europe bet big on American defense technology and they're now paying the price. Years-long backlogs are underway due to production delays and the U.S. own military needs.

breaking_news.headline: Aide to fugitive Ukrainian ex-PM wounded in latest Moscow car bombing
breaking_news.summary: Sergei Zavorotny, now a journalist and commentator, was previously an adviser to Ukrainian ex-prime minister Mykola Azarov.

breaking_news.headline: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge
breaking_news.summary: Maryland Senator Van Hollen says "new leadership" is needed for Democrats following the party's recent midterm successes.

breaking_news.headline: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own
breaking_news.summary: Pope Leo XIV is in Peru as part of his Latin America tour, just weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.

breaking_news.headline: German spies handed new powers to tackle 'hybrid threats' from abroad
breaking_news.summary: German reforms mean foreign and domestic intelligence services will have greater powers to combat espionage, terrorism and sabotage.

breaking_news.headline: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
breaking_news.summary: The fact the question of European security now features in discussions is viewed in Moscow as a victory, BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg says.

breaking_news.headline: Watch: How a server outage took down Microsoft Teams and Outlook
breaking_news.summary: A Microsoft outage is affecting services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot.

breaking_news.headline: Who is Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress - and who could take over permanently?
breaking_news.summary: Chief financial officer Colette Kress in in charge of Nvidia for now, but several others are in the frame as potential successors.

breaking_news.headline: Burnham says 'win-win' deal can be agreed between UK and EU
breaking_news.summary: The prime minister says the deal could be "more like the Brexit people thought they were voting for" in 2016.

breaking_news.headline: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to testify before Congress about affair with alleged Chinese spy
breaking_news.summary: Huang abruptly quit on Thursday as head of one of the world's most valuable companies after revelations of alleged extramarital affairs.

breaking_news.headline: Heat pumps: How much heat does your home really need?
breaking_news.summary: Knowing how much heat your home loses is important before installing a new heating system.

breaking_news.headline: The rise of 'housefishing' - when does using AI go from enhancing to misleading?
breaking_news.summary: Experts warn that using AI to enhance property images can go too far and mislead prospective buyers.

breaking_news.headline: Pressure grows on Trump's Commerce Secretary Lutnick in fallout from Nvidia scandal
breaking_news.summary: Scott Bessent told CNBC that several government agencies "were in favour of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months".
